June 2025 Texas Housing Market Update: Texas Just Flipped!
The Texas housing market has officially flipped. According to Redfin, there are nearly 500,000 more home sellers than buyers across the U.S., and Texas leads the way. In this video, we break down exactly what's happening in Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, El Paso, and the Fort Cavazos area — with data on price drops, buyer-to-seller ratios, and how you can take advantage of it whether you're buying or selling.

Buyers: Learn how to negotiate like a pro, what % below asking you can realistically offer, and which areas are offering huge builder incentives.
Sellers: Discover the 3 pillars you must get right (price, presentation, location) to beat this market and still attract multiple offers.

This is not clickbait. This is your June 2025 housing reality, explained in plain English. We also include data from Altos Research and Redfin to back up every claim.
